chose: A stage exports when its oldest waiting item arrived (stage_oldest_waiting_since_timestamp_seconds), and the recording rule stage:oldest_waiting:seconds ages it on every evaluation; never an age in seconds.
options: a timestamp, aged by a recording rule
an age gauge set once per pass
gray: An age set per pass stands still for a whole pass, and a broken transcriber's pass lasts hours (20 notes at 600 s each), which is exactly when it must move.
undo: Export the age as a gauge and drop the recording rule.
